stations.title: Kofi
stations.say: Why is the page so tiny on my phone?
stations.note: He is at the bus stop.

stations.title: Kofi's phone
stations.text: A tiny copy, and the picture runs off.

captions: Kofi opens the studio's page on his phone at the bus stop.
The phone shows a tiny copy of the big page, and the studio picture runs off the side.
You add the viewport line, pictures that shrink, rem sizes and a media query.
On the phone the class cards sit one above the other, big enough to read.
One page, every screen. The studio now has a page you built from a text file.
